# PDZ Restored: the native renderer's pipeline list. It holds only what fixes each pipeline: shader hashes,
# the vertex layout, the depth / blend / stencil / raster state, topology, target formats, the variant flags,
# and the hashes of the DXIL it was built with. No game code, no microcode, no translated shader code, no
# DXIL. At first start the game rebuilds each pipeline from the player's own translated shaders, before play.

#   | <attr:format:stream:offset;...>
